description: Tenders that agencies report to the state audit court, or publish on their own portal, and that are not on PNCP (today the TCE-RS LicitaCon, the TCE-PE and TCE-RN open data, the TCM-PA tender board and Sebrae's Canal do Fornecedor), most relevant first: agency, city, modality, opening date, values and the link to the tender on the source. Free. The sources are checked every 6 hours. `abertas=1` returns only the tenders that open today or later. A tender that is also on PNCP comes in `/api/busca`. `Accept: text/html` opens the Outside PNCP tab with the terms.

abertas.description: 1 for only the tenders that open today or later (optional).
